# CI-HERO-LAYOUT-RUNTIME-001

Authority: [#2274](https://github.com/anitaguptaoffice/sanguo-slg/issues/2274). New CI-only support on main `757e43a9f40d7c92ded6a536ec334de94d69ff6f`; one isolated Draft, never merge. No product or prior #2268/#2270 changes. Read-only diagnostic source `8be46c51c2c42f6c389bf0dd756409655b9646e7` maps to remote `b093c7b8c56192bca821aa2942dafffdb1315569`. Its original default-layout failures remain failures.

`withHeroRuntime(async context => ...)` owns actual startup, fresh account, one starter2004/template1017 recruitment, postcondition snapshots and cleanup. The context provides `page`, `panel`, `action(name)`, `hero`, `report`, `save()`, `responseAfter(action, route)`, `settled()` and `screenshot(label)`. Consumers perform normal UI input and read-only inspection; they must implement and assert their entire expected case list. Callback or cleanup failure makes the report fail. This module is not UI acceptance by itself.

The dependent four-cell workflow must pin approved product head/tree/ordered parents, runtime head/tree, QA head and files. It checks out runtime-source separately, runs this complete test file, copies the unmodified module alongside the consumer, and supplies QA_PRODUCT=standalone/reentry, QA_PRODUCT_HEAD, QA_PRODUCT_TREE, QA_PRODUCT_PARENTS, QA_RUNTIME_HEAD, QA_WIDTH=1280/1600, QA_OUT and QA_SERVER. Missing inputs or module fail. Import and pure tests start no services.

Official Ubuntu22.04 only, disposable PG17/Redis7 on loopback, database `live_hero_layout`, actual server/main.ts/Gateway/Vite6.4.5 and Playwright1.49.1 sandbox Chromium. First server boot creates DDL, then seven existing DATA-002 seeds, clean shutdown and second boot. Normal registration/city bootstrap and recruitment use no fixture. No gold initialization or training/other mutation. The entire lifecycle races a five-minute deadline or interruption; every synchronous command checks interruption and is limited by the remaining budget; absolute deadline checks reject synchronous overruns before success. Pending acquisitions reject and dispose late results before continuation. Readiness, failure screenshots and cleanup are separately bounded. No local browser/service/install retry.

Artifacts preserve full safe route order, non-auth hero mutation payloads/results, actual product/runtime/QA metadata, logs, PG snapshots, geometry and consumer screenshots. Never persist auth payloads, trace/session identifiers or credentials. Economy compares exact resource costs plus natural120food/hour using PG nanosecond checkpoints/remainders; hero/item/session state cannot change after recruitment. Exactly one successful Register/CreateCity/RecruitHero and only allowed read routes are accepted. Mutations are never retried.

Cleanup requires the owned child object, recorded positive PID, name, alive-before-stop and successful requested SIGTERM. Only asserted Vite6.4.5 preview may then return143/null; all other children require0/null. Prior exit, failed request, wrong child, signal, forced kill, remaining live process or other exit fails. Chromium also records and verifies its server object/positive PID, alive-before-close, requested close, forced-kill flag and0/null; early exit, wrong owner, failed close or live result fails. Failure screenshots/reports/logs survive ordinary errors; runner loss cannot imply PASS.

Run `node .github/scripts/live_hero_layout_runtime.test.mjs` and `node --check .github/scripts/live_hero_layout_runtime.mjs`. Tests call actual exported helpers:30 child and14 Chromium shutdown cases plus idempotency, bounded polls, hung-callback and synchronous-overrun deadline/interruption, remaining command budget, disposed late acquisition/no continuation, protocol mutation/missing/duplicate/failure, economy balance/checkpoint and redaction negatives. Tests are not live-service or browser acceptance. Final support, consumer and product combinations require independent exact-head review before any publication/official execution; review source-to-remote mapping and all four live artifacts separately.
